subject: NovaPrompt SDK adapter pilot / sandbox onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novaprompt.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: integrations@novaprompt.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot proposal: NovaPrompt SDK adapter for Redwood runtime

Hi Grace / Vanessa,

Thanks for taking the time on Friday. As discussed, NovaPrompt is ready to run a small integration pilot to validate our SDK adapter against Redwood's dedicated sandbox runtime. The goal is a lightweight adapter that demonstrates:

- streaming & structured output compatibility
- trace propagation for prompt -> model -> response
- a small perf bench (latency vs token throughput) on a 2-node sandbox

I've attached our current adapter spec (nova_adapter_spec_v1.pdf) and a signed NDA (nda-signed.pdf). We can provide a sample test dataset and a short MoP (pilot-mop.docx).

Asks from our side:
1) Sandbox credentials (short-lived) and an endpoint to push a small batch of test traffic.
2) Point of contact for telemetry integration (trace headers, span naming conventions).
3) A 30–45 minute kickoff on or around Dec 6 to align on acceptance criteria.

Proposed kickoff: Mon, Dec 6 10:00–10:45 PT (we can shift if that conflicts).

Thanks — excited to get this rolling.

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Integrations, NovaPrompt
elena@novaprompt.ai

---

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 10:03 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
> To: Elena Rossi <elena@novaprompt.ai>
> Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
> Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
> Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: NovaPrompt SDK adapter for Redwood runtime
>
> Hi Elena — thanks for the spec and NDA. I've reviewed the high-level scope and I think this is a good fit for a 3-week exploratory pilot.
>
> Quick answers to your asks:
> 1) We can provision a dedicated sandbox cluster (dev-dedicated-001) and hand over short-lived creds. Will need IP allowlist details if NovaPrompt will run from fixed egress.
> 2) Karthik (cc'd) is the best POC for telemetry/trace integration. He can map the trace/span expectations to our runtime.
> 3) Dec 6 morning PT works for an internal kickoff; I'll create a calendar invite after we lock time.
>
> Acceptance criteria (suggested):
> - Adapter passes basic compatibility tests (streaming + structured output)
> - End-to-end traces with at least 95% span correlation for 5k requests
> - A short perf artifact (p90 latency for 256-token responses)
>
> Two clarifying Qs:
> A) Does NovaPrompt require any kernel-level optimizations / custom ops in the runtime for quantized models?
> B) Are there any data retention / request logging needs beyond standard sandbox defaults?
>
> Attaching a short MoP template we use for pilots.
>
> Best,
> Grace
> Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
>
>

On Wed, Dec 2, 2026 at 08:11 AM Elena Rossi <elena@novaprompt.ai> wrote:
> From: Elena Rossi <elena@novaprompt.ai>
> To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
> Cc: integrations@novaprompt.ai
> Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:11:00 -0800
> Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: NovaPrompt SDK adapter for Redwood runtime
>
> Hi Grace — great, thanks. Quick answers:
> A) No kernel-level changes required for our v1 adapter; we rely on standard quantized kernels. If we hit perf gaps we'll raise a separate optimization ticket.
> B) For the pilot we'll only need request/response metadata (headers, timestamps) and traces; no raw customer data. We can supply synthetic PII-free test records.
>
> I've uploaded a short test corpus and some bench scripts to the drive link below. Also attaching the pilot MoP as you requested.
>
> Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyzNovaAdapter
>
> Can confirm Dec 6 at 10:00 PT for kickoff — sending invite now.
>
> Elena
>
>On Wed, Dec 2, 2026 at 09:30 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:

>Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: NovaPrompt SDK adapter for Redwood runtime
>
>Thanks for the details, Elena. A few internal notes and requests before the kickoff: 
>
>- Telemetry/Tracing: see attached telemetry-matrix.csv. We need to agree on the header names (x-rwd-trace-id / x-np-span) and ensure the SDK can forward incoming client trace ids into Redwood's span context.
>- Sampling: for the pilot we'd like 100% tracing on the sandbox to validate propagation; we can flip to adaptive sampling after validation.
>- Logs: possible to provide a short example of the request logs (one minute of sample traffic) so we can correlate? Carlos from DataBridge (cc'd) can help map storage and retention options if NovaPrompt wants to archive tracer artifacts.
>
>Operationally, if the adapter is a thin shim (no kernel mods) we can do a canary roll in the sandbox and run perf tests in parallel. We should capture a post-pilot runbook with rollback criteria.
>
>Karthik
>Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
>
>
